channel.title: A Student's Guide to Maxwell's Equations — Audio Companion
channel.description: Personal RSS wrapper for Dan Fleisch's publicly published audio companion to A Student's Guide to Maxwell's Equations. Audio remains hosted by danfleisch.com; this feed only organizes the published MP3 links for podcast apps.
